sibling_anchor: rawlsing_next/pre553_structural_admission.py (D15 STRUCTURAL_EMPIRICAL_ADMISSION_AUTHORITY, the immediate sibling row in the same D15 ledger)

owner_collision.method: searched all of rawlsing_next for any existing service_source_applicability / SERVICE_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY owner before implementing

placement_idiom.exact_ref_idiom: pre553_empirical_objects.exact_ref / authority_ref / canonical_json / semantic_hash reused verbatim
placement_idiom.deterministic_replay: semantic_hash over the exact receipt material
placement_idiom.fail_closed_conflicts: UNKNOWN_OR_CONFLICTING_APPLICABILITY_AUTHORITY folds to public UNRESOLVED so ambiguity is never read as a negative finding

state_family.name: SERVICE_SOURCE_APPLICABILITY_STATE
state_family.why_new: NOT_APPLICABLE, NONCOMPARABLE and OUT_OF_SCOPE each already appear in more than one existing STATE_FAMILY. Aliasing would make an applicability refusal indistinguishable from a relation refusal and destroy D15's separation in the type system itself.

precedence_is_meaningful: ordered so a failure or refusal at a higher position can never be reported as, or silently converted into, a lower-position state

ratified_strichter_vocabulary_preserved.note: the ratified derivation carried a 10-value exact decision precedence and a 7-value public state map, both stricter and more specific than the commission's minimum enumeration. Both were implemented verbatim rather than replaced by the commission's shorter list.

typed_outcomes.ADMISSIBLE_SOURCE_INDEXED_SET: positive, COMPLETE coverage, one or more admitted
typed_outcomes.ADMISSIBLE_SOURCE_INDEXED_SET__COVERAGE_: positive-shaped but coverage INCOMPLETE; carries known per-source findings and is explicitly not a complete admissible set
typed_outcomes.NO_ADMITTED_SOURCE_IN_CANDIDATE_CLASS: first-class SUCCESS, COMPLETE coverage only, carries per-candidate typed state and reason for EVERY candidate

candidate_class_coverage.COMPLETE_means: every candidate in the positively bounded candidate class received a TERMINAL decision
candidate_class_coverage.INCOMPLETE_means: at least one candidate is undecided
candidate_class_coverage.implementation_note: the derivation illustrated INCOMPLETE with UNDETERMINED_NO_POSITIVE_AUTHORITY. This implementation uses the general definition (any non-terminal decision), which is strictly safer because COMPLETE can never be reported while any candidate is undecided.

applicability_predates_evidence.enforced_by: ServiceSourceApplicabilityDecision.REQUIRED_FIELDS is exact and contains NO internal-evidence-sufficiency field; FORBIDDEN_FIELDS enumerates evidence/support/sufficiency/sample-size fields that may never appear
